findings.text: residual_split duplicates bank_solve_trace_head/report.py:45 invocations almost verbatim, and the reason the manifest gives for the fork reproduces only at one width - I called the owner at width 16 on this run's own captures and it returned {'read': 31.947157, 'update': 24.344575}, identical to the copy, while at width 1 it raises at bank_solve_trace_head/report.py:89 assert counts_by_symbol; the real defect is that width-specific strip inventory, which belongs to the owner module this node was fenced out of, so the repair is to make that block conditional there rather than to carry a second copy of the scope split that will drift.

the launcher is a second copy of bank_solve_trace_head/device.sh differing in three lines only - --cpus-per-task 2 to 4, the module name, and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE - so the same sbatch recipe, the same header printf and the same EXIT sentinel now exist twice and a change to either will not reach the other.

the receipts that validate the reporter - report-complete.log, omitted-group.log - record '# revision: 276a3cab1ecfb043d33e4971ff09558865708b50', the commit that does not contain report.py, because the header prints git HEAD while the file was still untracked, so a reader following the recorded revision finds no reporter; I closed the gap by re-running the committed file at 7d4813b, but the recorded provenance still points one commit early.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 360c086 - 276a3cab adds capture.py, device.py and device.sh (96 lines, wrapping bank_solve_trace_head.device and bank_solve_trace.capture by import) and 7d4813b adds report.py (401 lines), the evidence fragment (242 lines) and the SVG; no product code or test appears in either commit.
item_verdicts.done_when: every clause of the measure is present and reproducible - the fragment carries 75 table rows that match the run's tables.html exactly, and I re-ran the committed reporter at 7d4813b against the run's captures and got EXIT=0, an identical summary.json, an identical tables.html and an SVG differing only in its timestamp and random marker ids.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to attribute the four-read batched solve wall on one H200 at current main, and docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-solve-trace-four-read.html:10-36 gives device ms, launches and share for every source group at 1 and 16 slices, splits per-read from per-update cost, and states the four-read floor as 277.365 ms per batch (17.335 ms per slice) against the 16 ms sixteen-slice target.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; status complete, two commits listed, six changed paths, reads 4 and updates 3 at both widths, walls 303.291 and 303.659 ms, floor 277.267 and 277.463 ms, no suite armed with the reason that product and tests are unchanged, which the empty nova//tests/ diff confirms.
item_verdicts.write_paths: both commits touch six paths and every one sits inside the three declared grants - scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_trace_four_read, the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path, and docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-solve-trace-four-read - while git diff 360c086..7d4813b over nova/ and tests/ is empty.

justifications.durability: report.py:220 asserts reads == 4 and :218 asserts convergence and residual <= 1e-10, so a regression to five reads or a stalled solve reddens the reporter, and I measured the accounting control firing at report.py:385 through omitted-group.log EXIT=1, but nothing in the committed suite runs these scripts, so the guard fires only when an H200 capture is re-taken and re-reported by hand.
justifications.evidence: the gate is the recorded H200 job - sacct shows job 1307440 betelgeuse gres/gpu=1 mem=48G COMPLETED 00:06:31 on 98dci4-gpu-0003, matching bank-solve-trace-four-read.html:59-61 - and capture-1.log:858 and capture-2.log:858 both report reads [4,...,4] with residual 4.135358722123783e-12, but the receipts that validate report.py name revision 276a3cab, which does not contain it.
justifications.fit: capture.py:1-6 and device.py:1-6 follow the E402-after-configure_dtypes and monkeypatched-owner idiom of their neighbours, and no added symbol or comment carries a plan label or ticket number, though report.py:100-140 embeds the figure layout and renaming inline where the surrounding prototypes keep plotting helpers in a module.
justifications.goal_fidelity: bank-solve-trace-four-read.html:24-29 carries the four-read floor, the three dominant groups and their launch scaling, which is the whole of what the goal asked for and nothing beyond it.
justifications.reuse: report.py:37 residual_split re-implements scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_trace_head/report.py:45 invocations line for line - the same wall-loop count, the same assert sum == reads at :49, the same newton_step versus .magnitude scope split, the same enclosing[-1] fallback and the same invocations receipt write - and at width 16 the owner returns exactly the split the copy returns, so the addition duplicates an owned capability instead of extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diffstat of 360c086..7d4813b lists exactly the six declared paths and no file under nova/ or tests/, so nothing outside the grants and nothing the goal does not imply was touched.
